caption: The drawing depicts a four-poster bed with a canopy, shown in perspective from the front-left side, alongside a close-up detail of one of its bedposts. The bed has four tall, turned wooden posts, each featuring carved vertical grooves and decorative elements, all in a medium brown wood tone. The canopy on top is rectangular and covered with white fabric that is pleated and drapes slightly over the edges. The headboard is wooden and has a curved design. The bed is dressed with a pink quilted bedspread that has a white lattice pattern, and a long white bed skirt with vertical subtle blue lines drapes down from the mattress, covering the lower area. To the right of the bed, there is an enlarged view of one of the wooden bedposts, showing detailed carved patterns and a finial at the top, colored the same medium brown as the bed frame, and the base of the post appears unfinished or incomplete at the very bottom. The background of the drawing is plain, light beige, with no additional objects or decorations.
title: Four Post Bed
